rows.grounds: compound epithet: bhairava-ādhāra-tattva-jñā, feminine agentive knower of the foundational truth of Bhairava
compound epithet: bhairava-ādhāra-tattva-dā, feminine agentive giver of the foundational truth of Bhairava

items.question: What dual role does the goddess hold regarding the foundational truth of Bhairava?
premises: The goddess is identified as the knower of the foundational truth of Bhairava.
The goddess is identified as the giver of the foundational truth of Bhairava.
items.inference: The goddess both possesses and bestows the foundational truth of Bhairava.
uncertainties: The precise sense of ādhāra as support, basis, or substrate remains context-dependent.
items.plain_english: She is the knower of the foundational truth of Bhairava and the giver of that foundational truth.
